blocks.text: Cells ki daryaft (discovery), aur phir cell ki andaruni banawat (structure) ka mazeed mutala, microscope ke istemal par munhasir (dependent) tha. Microscopy woh technique hai jis mein microscopes se un cheezon ko dekha aur parha jata hai jo nangi aankh se nazar nahin aatin. Microscopes lenses aur roshni (light) ya electron beams se namoone (specimens) ko bara aur roshan karte hain.

Light microscope mein cheez ka image banane ke liye roshni istemal hoti hai. Roshni cheez mein se guzarti hai aur phir do sheeshe (glass) ke lenses mein se. Ek lens cheez ka bara image banata hai aur doosra lens us image ko aur bara karta hai. Cheez aur lenses se guzarne ke baad roshni dekhne wale ki aankh mein cheez ka bara aur saaf image banati hai.
Yeh microscopes ki do kaleedi (key) khususiyat (characteristics) hain.

blocks.title: Magnification
blocks.text: Microscope ki cheez ke image ko bara karne ki salahiyat (ability). Mukhtalif lenses mukhtalif darje (levels) ki magnification dete hain. Ise X ki alamat se likhte hain, jo batati hai ke image asal size se kitne guna bara nazar aata hai: 10X lens 1 µm ki cheez ko 10 µm bana deta hai. Kul magnification tamam lenses ki magnification ko zarb (multiply) dene se milti hai.

blocks.title: Resolution
blocks.text: Microscope ki kisi cheez par do qareeb nuqton ko alag-alag dikhane ki salahiyat. Resolution jitni zyada, utni bareek tafseel (detail) dekhi ja sakti hai. Nangi insani aankh taqreeban 0.1 mm tak resolve karti hai; light microscope taqreeban 250 nm tak ki tafseel resolve karta hai.

Light microscope ki magnification 1500X hai: yeh cheezon ko taqreeban 1500 guna bara kar sakta hai. Is ki resolving power 0.2 micrometre (µm) hai, aur 1 µm ek millimetre ka hazarwan hissa hai. Doosre lafzon mein light microscope 0.2 µm se chhoti cheezon mein farq nahin kar sakta.

Light microscopes zinda jandaron ko dekhne ke liye faida-mand hain, magar kyunke alag-alag cells aam taur par shaffaf (transparent) hote hain, un ke hisse tab tak nazar nahin aate jab tak unhen khaas stains (rangdar chemicals) se rang na diya jaye. Magar staining aam taur par cells ko maar deti hai.

Electron microscope mein electrons ka beam cheez mein se guzarta hai. Magnetic lenses electron beam ko screen ya photographic film par focus karte hain aur bohat bara image banate hain. Is ki resolving power light microscope se kahin zyada hai: yeh 0.2 nanometre (nm) tak ki chhoti cheezen saaf dikha sakta hai, aur 1 nm ek millimetre ka das lakhwan (one millionth) hissa hai. Magar electron microscope zinda mawad dekhne ke liye istemal nahin ho sakta, kyunke namoone tayyar karne ke tareeqe aise hain. Biologists do qisam ke electron microscope istemal karte hain.

items: Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM): cell ki andaruni banawat dekhne ke liye. TEM electrons ka beam bohat patle namoone mein se guzarta hai. Yeh cheezon ko 250,000 guna tak bara kar sakta hai.

Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM): cells ya doosri cheezon ki satah (surface) ki tafseel dekhne ke liye. Satah par dhaat (metal) ki tah chadhai jati hai; jab electron beam dhaat se takrata hai to woh palat (reflect) kar bara image banata hai. SEM 100,000 guna tak bara karta hai.

blocks.alt: Teen columns. Baen: light microscope, neeche lamp se roshni namoone, objective lens aur eyepiece lens se guzar kar aankh tak jati hai. Darmiyan: transmission electron microscope, upar electron gun se beam magnetic lenses aur bohat patle murda namoone se guzar kar fluorescent screen par girta hai. Daen: scanning electron microscope, scanning coils beam ko dhaat-chadhi satah par ghumate hain aur palte hue electrons detector tak pohanchte hain.
blocks.caption: Light microscope, TEM aur SEM image kaise banate hain (Figures 3.2 aur 3.4 ke mutabiq asal diagram).
blocks.long_description: Light microscope nazar aane wali roshni aur sheeshe ke lenses se kaam karta hai aur zinda ya stained namoone 1500X tak 0.2 µm ki resolution ke saath dikhata hai. TEM electrons ko patle murda namoone mein se guzarta hai, magnetic lenses se focus kar ke, aur andaruni banawat 250,000X tak dikhata hai. SEM beam ko dhaat-chadhi satah par ghumata hai aur palte hue electrons jama kar ke satah ki tafseel 100,000X tak dikhata hai. Dono electron microscopes 0.2 nm tak resolve karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek talib-e-ilm kehta hai ke 100X objective aur 15X eyepiece wala light microscope 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqton ko alag-alag dikhayega. Is dawe mein kya ghalat hai?
blocks.explanation: Kul magnification 100 × 15 = 1500X hai, jo light microscope ki had hai, magar magnification resolution nahin hai. Light microscope taqreeban 0.2 µm se qareeb kuch resolve nahin kar sakta, is liye 0.1 µm ke fasle par do nuqte chahe kitne bhi bare kiye jayen ek mein mil jayenge. Electron microscope, jo 0.2 nm resolve karta hai, unhen alag kar sakta hai.

items: Magnification yeh hai ke image kitne guna bara hai (lenses zarb hote hain); resolution woh sab se chhota fasla hai jo do nuqton ke taur par dekha ja sake.
Light microscope: roshni aur sheeshe ke lenses; 1500X tak; 0.2 µm resolve karta hai; zinda ya stained namoone, magar staining aam taur par cells maar deti hai.
Electron microscope: electron beam aur magnetic lenses; 0.2 nm resolve karta hai; murda, khaas tayyar-shuda namoone. TEM andaruni banawat dikhata hai (250,000X); SEM satah dikhata hai (100,000X).
